high_level_description: The image depicts a furniture store display featuring a set of wooden furniture with red cushions. The main focus is on two matching armchairs with slatted backs and armrests, each adorned with a red cushion. Between the armchairs, there is a small wooden coffee table with a slatted design, also featuring a red cushion on top. A green and white patterned throw pillow is placed on the backrest of one of the armchairs. In the background, there are other pieces of furniture, including a sofa with a light blue cushion and a brown leather armchair.
